{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kuari suite''', along with the [[Emperor suite]], was one of the two luxury suites on the [[Bazaar Deck]] of the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. Both suites featured deluxe refreshments centers, split-level entertainment room, [[holo-overlay projector]] with [[sensory adapter]], a stock of vintage [[Pludris]], original [[kinesculpture]] by [[Xephi Sep]], private [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[butler]], [[zero-g sauna]], and private [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. Each suite cost a thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a [[Standard day/Legends|day]].
